body.title: Array Sum (Structured E2E)
body.problem_statement: Write a C++17 program that reads an integer N followed by N integers and prints their sum.
body.input_format: The first line contains one integer N (1 <= N <= 100). The second line contains N integers A1 ... AN separated by single spaces (-1000000000 <= Ai <= 1000000000).
body.output_format: Print the sum A1 + A2 + ... + AN as a decimal integer followed by a newline. Print nothing else.
body.additional_constraints: Use C++17. Read from standard input and write to standard output. The sum can exceed the 32-bit integer range.
